intro: Crystal Shore is a stretch of sandy coastline along the southeastern edge of Stranglethorn Vale, washed by the waves of the South Seas. Tucked beneath steep coastal bluffs, the beach lies just south of the ancient Ruins of Aboraz and across the waters from Jaguero Isle.

p: Running along the southeastern perimeter of Stranglethorn Vale, the Crystal Shore forms a natural boundary between the dense tropical interior and the open waters of the South Seas. The beach itself is walled off from the inland jungles by steep ridges, leaving only a couple of rugged passes for travelers attempting to move between the coast and the deeper wilderness of Mistvale Valley. To the north lie the crumbling troll structures of the Ruins of Aboraz, while the Wild Shore extends along the southern curves of the cape. Its location makes it a quiet, windswept margin far removed from the bustling docks of Booty Bay.
